name: cfcmt-v93-fresh-confirmation-20261106
purpose: Fresh-seed confirmation of the frozen V93 complete control pipeline versus three pressure policies, with the original V93 results retained separately.

fixed_controller.los_angeles: Original unguarded target anchor and sparse coordinator
fixed_controller.jinan: Original Atlanta source component, source weight 1, within-component alpha 0.9, guard beta 0.5, sparse coordinator
fixed_controller.only_experimental_change: SUMO evaluation seed; frozen models, networks, demands, controller parameters and execution timing remain original

primary_population: All departed vehicles including unfinished trips at the 3600-second endpoint; waiting includes warm-up.
primary_estimand: For each paired seed, first average the three Jinan scenario waiting means. Compute (V93-comparator)/comparator separately in each city, then average the two city ratios equally, then average all 56 seeds. Negative favors V93.

bootstrap.resampling_unit: Complete paired seed blocks shared across cities, scenarios and methods
bootstrap.interval: Percentile 2.5 and 97.5; same resample indices for the three comparators within each scope

statistical_test.test: Two-sided paired Wilcoxon signed-rank on seed-level relative changes
statistical_test.multiplicity: Holm9 over three comparators by three scopes

decision_rule: For each comparator/scope, confirm a waiting advantage only when the paired mean relative change is negative, its 95% bootstrap upper endpoint is below zero, and Holm9 p<0.05. Report all nine comparisons, raw means, ties and adverse seeds. Non-confirmation is not a claim of zero benefit.
secondary_reporting: Ratio of scope means, explicitly distinct from the primary mean of paired city ratios
Raw collision records, collision-event steps, deduplicated collision incidents, teleport starts and ends
Exact GP outcome ties and complete learned-action counters

cohort_handling.missing_or_failed_runs: Remain missing and prevent final confirmation analysis; never encode as zero or drop a seed
cohort_handling.technical_retry: No automatic rerun. If an identical-identity technical retry is separately authorized, preserve the first failure and use unchanged seed/settings.

pre_run_admission: Local seed novelty PASS in seed_novelty.json
Server visible historical/config/result seed novelty PASS in a separate receipt
Frozen runtime and original controller assets bound by the runner receipt
Technical smoke uses only previously used seeds; do not inspect a fresh confirmation seed to tune or debug
scope: Fresh simulator-seed generalization on the same two target geometries. This panel evaluates complete pipelines and learned increments over GP; it does not isolate cross-city source-data effects or add unseen target cities.
storage: Keep raw logs, tripinfo XML, networks and models on the server. Pull compact scalar JSON/CSV and short logs only.

analysis_input.extra_columns: Allowed, including result_path and full scalar guard counters
analysis_input.completeness: Exactly all 896 unique preregistered identities and finite metrics; run validity and frozen-runtime provenance are supplied by the collection receipt
